 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Admin
 participant PC as PaymentController
 participant PO as PaymentOrchestrator
 participant IV as InvoiceValidation
 participant PSF as PaymentServiceFactory
 participant PS as PaymentService
 participant INV as InventoryService

 Admin->>PC: RefundRequest{invoiceId}
 PC->>PO: processInvoiceRefund(request)
 PO->>IV: validateCanRefund(invoice)
 PO->>PO: find SUCCESS payment for invoice
 PO->>PSF: getPaymentService(payment.paymentMethod)
 PSF-->>PO: PaymentService impl
 PO->>PS: refund(payment)
 PS-->>PO: payment marked REFUNDED
 PO->>INV: addStock(product, qty) per invoice item
 PO->>PO: invoice.setInvoiceStatus(CANCELED)
 PO-->>PC: RefundResponse",
 "config": null
